Text (verbatim): "01 MEADOW".
Landscape: sunny green meadow, winding sand path, wooden windmill, broad round tree crowns. Palette leaf green, cream, honey tan. Text (verbatim): "03 STARLIT MARSH".
Landscape: luminous turquoise marsh at blue-hour twilight, wide lily pads, shallow mirror pools, reeds, tiny distant starlights. Not a space battlefield. Palette milk white, clear turquoise, deep teal with very small amber light accents. Faction flowing water-and-mist spirits; round soft gelatinous outlines and simplified single reflection marks. 01 existing cloud healer ally, small cream-white storm cloud body, two dot eyes, flowing aqua mist tassels below, compact drifting silhouette. 02 existing droplet otter ally, pear-shaped pale aqua body, short paddle tail, carrying a round water bubble in its paws. 03 NEW lamp-shell snail enemy, low long water-droplet snail, one big curled shell containing a single soft amber dot, two broad short antennae. 04 NEW salamander sentry enemy, wide blunt head and horizontal crescent tail, two huge smooth water-glass forearms held as a guard, short hind legs, dusky teal. 05 NEW lotus toad miniboss, extremely wide low toad with huge round cheek sacs and a single broad lotus leaf draped over its back, slow stomp stance, clear pond-animal face. 06 NEW waterlily jellyfish sovereign boss, enormous low-domed translucent jelly bell with 5 thick rounded lotus-petal lobes and 4 long ribbon tentacles touching the ground, two gentle dot eyes under dome, broad arch silhouette, NOT whale, NOT humanoid, no thin tentacle clutter.

Text (verbatim): "04 FROST HARBOR".

Palette warm off-white fur, cobalt blue, muted brick-red scarves; cheerful cold daylight, not darknight. Faction winter migrating animals with thick coats and practical snow equipment. 01 existing snowflake penguin ally retaining its dark plum layered cloak, pale cream face, triangular beak and angular hood, tiny blue ice accent; do not turn this existing darkcloaked character into white recolor. 02 NEW snow-shovel seal ally, plump cream seal with small flippers, oversized broad rounded blue-gray snow shovel held sideways as a shield, short red scarf and draggingtail. 03 NEW snowball lemming enemy, tiny round brown-white rodent rolling a snowball almost its size, broad little paws, low nimble silhouette. 04 NEW iron-horn musk ox enemy, squat shaggy warm-brown barrel body, enormous low curved ivory horns, snow on rounded hump, four little feet, no armor. 05 NEW sled walrus miniboss, huge sitting walrus with big mustache and paired downward tusks, short wide wooden sled-frame used as a front guard, massive spherical body. 06 NEW floe mammoth boss, towering arched brown wool back carrying one broad ice slab, long thick trunk, two huge ivory crescent tusks framing head, columnar feet, extremely recognizable outline distinct from bears or boars. No ornate armor, icy recolor swarm, holiday branding or new extra characters.

Text (verbatim): "05 SHADE THEATER".
Landscape: abandoned forest traveling theater at warm dusk, deep burgundy curtains, a wooden toy stage, folded paper scenery, warm round footlights. Friendly eerie fairy-tale, not horror. Palette aubergine cloth, wine red, aged ivory paper, honey wood with pale lavender highlights. NEW faction Mask Puppets: cloth seams, big paper folds, wooden ball joints, animal-shaped theatrical creatures, never human mannequins. 01 NEW thread-knot mouse ally, small cream cloth mouse with one oversized knotted tail, needle-shaped wooden staff used like a wand (blunt), small spool strapped to back, round friendly face, one largevisible stitch not elaborate sewing. 02 NEW folding-umbrella crow ally, small black-plum crow with pale beak, oversized closed burgundy umbrella slanted forward like a lance, wings made of two clear folded cloth panels, compact seated bird silhouette. 03 NEW drum puppet enemy, squat cylindrical wooden drum body, two short hinged feet, simple curved animal-mask face, two padded drumstick arms, burgundy fabric hem. 04 NEW folded-paper bird enemy, tall angular origami heron made of aged ivory paper, one zigzag neck, big triangular folded beak, two thick stick legs, one plum fold line; no humanoid spear soldier. 05 NEW accordion weasel acrobat miniboss, long rounded cream weasel head on a concertina cloth-and-wood spring body emerging from a large squat toybox, exaggerated curvinghorizontal silhouette, simple friendly mischievousface. 06 NEW grand-curtain puppet boss, massive animal-faced theatrical marionette, wide burgundy stage-curtain cape making a huge trapezoid silhouette, crescent ivory owl-like mask, two large wooden paddle paws and short balljoint legs, visible topcrossbar with two thick strings as partofbody silhouette, no human face, no spooky skull, no crown, no invisibility aura.
